name: joplin-plugin-note-dashboard
description: Joplin plugin: sidebar dashboard with Today / Next workday / Later to-do buckets, drag-and-drop rescheduling, recently opened and pinned notes.
author: Jan Stuhlmann

scripts.dist: webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildMain && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildExtraScripts && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=createArchive
scripts.test: tsc src/dashboard.ts --outDir .test-build --module commonjs --target es2019 && node tests/dashboard.test.js
scripts.update: npm install -g generator-joplin && yo joplin --node-package-manager npm --update --force
